notes: Company snapshot: mid-market product SaaS (B2B); real-time chat + knowledge base; heavy embeddings use for search and rerank
Primary goals: reduce per-token inference cost ~30% vs hosted baseline while keeping p95 < 120ms and p99 < 200ms
Throughput target: baseline 200 qps for chat generation during peak; steady-state embeddings batch jobs ~30 qps
Model preference: open models (Llama-family / Mistral) validated in POC; will accept Redwood-verified variants with quantization
Routing needs: low-latency region affinity (NA primary, EU for EU users), automated fallback to smaller model on overload
Security: SSO (SAML), tenant VPC option, customer-managed KMS, audit logging with 90-day retention (negotiable)
POC learnings: Redwood hosted delivered ~15% lower p95 latency vs Competitor X at 512 tokens due to KV-prefix caching; caching reduced invocation cost by ~12%
Pricing ask (current): propose 3 commit tiers + explicit ramp schedule. Want burst capacity 2x baseline for short windows (max 72 hours) and predictable overage caps
Draft commercial terms requested by finance: 12-mo and 24-mo commit options; 30% discount at 24-mo on committed usage; overage pricing target <= 1.75x committed unit price
Example proposed ramp (high-level): month1 25% of committed baseline, month2 50%, month3 75%, month4 onward full commit. Finance prefers front-loaded discounts if commit stays steady
Operational SLO: 99.9% availability for Dedicated pool; clear escalation path (SE + on-call) for production incidents
Legal: must add data residency appendix for EU traffic + encryption in transit & at rest with customer KMS; early termination requires 60 days notice and prorated refunds

Next steps agreed: Redwood SE to deliver a granular cost model (18-month view) with commit tiers, burst policy, and estimated overage exposure; Finance to confirm budget range
